intent: Re-cut the complete high-risk PR #1185 change onto exact current main and close the remaining live review-packet publication finding without weakening merge admission. Preserve exact-head and immutable-evidence binding; fail closed when receipt binding context is incomplete; make fanout status use the exact packet bindings; reduce review-thread GraphQL to complete paginated resolution/outdated state while excluding comment payloads from merge truth; enforce the existing deterministic embedded-evidence byte ceiling before any reviewer subprocess; persist compare metadata without duplicating the complete diff inside FACTS.json; publish a packet directory only after all bounded evidence and both prompts are complete; retain current-base/current-head risk recomputation and a short gate-to-merge base/head revalidation while allowing an unchanged reviewed three-dot range to survive base changes; and keep every per-PR fanout stage isolated so one unreadable pull request cannot suppress later queue receipts. This remains the sole final PR-range packet because canonical policy permits exactly one changed Session Entry packet for a high-risk pull request.

commit.message: fix(mike): publish bounded review packets atomically [impact-checked]

interface_mismatches: Canonical PR-range policy permits exactly one changed Session Entry packet for a high-risk pull request; the earlier packet and this follow-up packet were both absent at the merge base, so the earlier packet is removed from the final tree and this packet declares the cumulative committed range without claiming retroactive pre-edit admission.

The final repair is re-cut from exact current main 726a54472fa163c179465033ba2577d5f65a3d96; the published predecessor ef0466de165535eca718cad0ad9edd54d8b4fa6f remains preserved in Git history and local backup custody.

Review evidence retains the complete immutable diff exactly once in DIFF.patch; compare-file metadata in FACTS.json excludes only GitHub's duplicate per-file patch payload, while rename provenance and risk fields remain intact.

Packet construction stages outside the selectable pr-N namespace and performs a no-clobber final-directory rename only after the bounded evidence snapshot and both reviewer prompts are complete; failed builds cannot become the newest packet.

Long-lived reviewer authority remains bound to the immutable head, three-dot review range, and evidence digest, while live base/head risk and the short gate-to-merge compare-and-swap are re-read immediately before authority so review-range-preserving base changes do not create permanent queue churn.
Legacy unbound local review receipts become invalid and must be regenerated; this intentionally removes stale local authority rather than adding a compatibility bypass.

Canonical owner policy deliberately counts a trusted Codex COMMENTED review while complete review threads carry substantive findings; a body-only blocking comment with no thread remains an owner-policy residual and is not silently redefined by this repair.
GitHub exposes a head-OID guard but no base-OID CAS for direct or deferred PR merge; merge execution remains disabled unless canonical live policy proves strict and up-to-date base enforcement.

AgentOps negative-control jails resolve the base interpreter without virtualenv site-packages, so the ten fail-closed controls use a stdlib-only unittest module while the positive focused gate also collects that module under pytest.
honest_blockers: The remaining exact-head review thread stays unresolved until its reviewer validates the final pushed repair; this session does not resolve it on the author's behalf.

The 524288-byte embedded-evidence ceiling remains fail closed after duplicate patch removal; genuinely larger immutable review ranges must be split or handled through explicit human review rather than silently truncated.

Receipt reuse after base movement remains contingent on an identical immutable three-dot review range; a changed range or failed exact comparison remains blocked and requires packet and review regeneration.
WP-0F2 cannot retire until WP-0F1 operator policy is ratified and all required consumers are reverified on merged main.
Human merge approval remains required; this packet grants no merge, approval, deploy, or gate-bypass authority.
Merge execution remains mechanically disabled until WP-0F1 proves and wires canonical strict and up-to-date base enforcement.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the complete PR repair range and its consolidated packet together; the earlier packet and all repair commits remain recoverable in branch history.
